answer: Bots that wander a single backbone can pack every payout drawer. To open one cell in the glacier vault, lock 11.25 POA for 26 hours and post a 28-byte commitment to the xor of the last 72 finalized headers, revealed only after a 16-minute quiet. The k-th sibling key on the same ASN pays 0.65 POA times k-cubed. Three keepers replay the xor and admit one live cell per commitment. If two reveals collide, the quiet is skipped, or one commitment opens two cells, 2.85 POA is burned and that cluster is kept off the vault for eleven epochs.
